description: This PHP class 'redminerestInterface' implements an interface for integrating with Redmine issue tracker via REST API. It includes methods for connecting, retrieving, creating issues, and adding notes, with configuration handling and API interaction.

classes.name: redminerestInterface
classes.description: A class for Redmine issue tracker integration via REST API, providing methods for issue management and configuration.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object used for Redmine API interactions.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID has a valid syntax, delegating to checkBugIDSyntaxNumeric.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Redmine by initializing API client and verifying project access.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Redmine is established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves issue details from Redmine given an issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a specified issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue (currently same as status code).

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string of the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if an issue exists in Redmine by ID.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine with provided summary, description, and options.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note to an existing issue in Redmine.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration string for setting up Redmine integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates if issues can be created via API based on configuration.
